title.hg: Law ke Words, Simple Bhasha Mein

def.en: A rule made by the government that everyone in the country must follow. Breaking it can lead to punishment.
def.hg: Government ka banaya rule, jise desh ke har insaan ko follow karna hota hai. Isse todne par saza ho sakti hai.

def.en: Something every person is entitled to, such as safety, education and privacy. Nobody can take it away just because you are young.
def.hg: Aisi cheez jis par har insaan ka haq hai, jaise safety, education aur privacy. Sirf isliye ki tum chhote ho, koi isse chheen nahi sakta.

def.en: India's law that protects everyone under 18 from sexual offences. Its full name is the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.
def.hg: India ka woh law jo 18 se kam umar ke har insaan ko sexual offences se protect karta hai. Iska poora naam hai Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

def.en: Under POCSO, any person who has not yet turned 18, even if they look or feel grown up.
def.hg: POCSO ke under har woh insaan jo abhi 18 saal ka nahi hua, chahe woh bada dikhta ho ya bada feel karta ho.

def.en: A phone number you can call for help, such as 1098 for children or 112 in an emergency. The call is free.
def.hg: Aisa phone number jis par help ke liye call kiya ja sakta hai, jaise bachchon ke liye 1098 ya emergency mein 112. Call free hoti hai.

def.en: The rule that an adult who knows a child has been sexually harmed must tell the police. They cannot keep it secret.
def.hg: Woh rule jiske under jis adult ko pata ho ki kisi bachche ke saath sexual harm hua hai, usse police ko batana hi hota hai. Woh isse secret nahi rakh sakta.

def.en: The written record the police make when told about a serious offence. It starts the investigation, and the person reporting is entitled to a free copy.
def.hg: Woh written record jo police kisi serious offence ki information milne par banati hai. Isi se investigation shuru hoti hai, aur report karne wale ko iski free copy milne ka haq hai.

def.en: India's main criminal code since 1 July 2024. It replaced the Indian Penal Code and defines offences such as rape, sexual harassment, voyeurism and stalking.
def.hg: 1 July 2024 se India ka main criminal code. Isne Indian Penal Code ki jagah li aur rape, sexual harassment, voyeurism aur stalking jaise offences define karta hai.

def.en: Free legal help, including a lawyer, provided through the Legal Services Authorities to women, children and others who qualify.
def.hg: Free legal help, jisme lawyer bhi shaamil hai, jo Legal Services Authorities ke through women, children aur doosre eligible logon ko milti hai.

def.en: A professional's duty to keep your information private. In India it has legal limits, such as mandatory reporting when someone under 18 is abused.
def.hg: Kisi professional ki yeh duty ki woh tumhari information private rakhe. India mein iski legal limits hain, jaise 18 se kam umar ke insaan ke abuse par mandatory reporting.

def.en: The Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act, 1971, amended in 2021, which sets the conditions under which abortion is legal in India.
def.hg: Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act, 1971, jisme 2021 mein amendment hua, aur jo decide karta hai ki India mein abortion kin conditions par legal hai.

def.en: A police unit trained to handle matters involving children. Offences under POCSO can be reported to it or to the local police.
def.hg: Police ki woh unit jise bachchon se jude matters handle karne ki training mili hoti hai. POCSO ke under offences ki report isse ya local police ko di ja sakti hai.
